• Article 44 – Uniform Civil Code.

rows: Agriculture, animal husbandry, and protection of environment

items: Article 44 (Uniform Civil Code) is one of the most frequently tested Directive Principles in Polity MCQs.
Article 50 (Separation of Judiciary from Executive) is commonly asked in judicial and civil services examinations.
Article 51 is often cited in questions regarding the constitutional basis of India's foreign policy.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 44 aims to secure a Uniform Civil Code for citizens throughout India.
Article 45 mandates early childhood care and education.
Articles 48 and 48A direct the state to organize agriculture, animal husbandry, and protect the environment.
Article 49 focuses on the protection of monuments and objects of national importance.
Article 50 directs the state to separate the judiciary from the executive in public services.
Article 51 directs the promotion of international peace and security.
